(https://www.ugc.gov.in/pdfnews/5323630_New_Draft_UGCRegulation-
2018-9-2.pdf )
All the applicants are advised to send/submit hard copy of their
applications to the Director, University Institute of Legal Studies, Panjab
University, Chandigarh along with all self attested copies of their certificates
and other relevant documents including publications for verification along
with the duly filled application form and template pages 1 to 11
(https://forms.puchd.ac.in/forms/20200122155429-
directrecruitmentassistantprofessorapplicationformasperugcregulation2018.
pdf ) on or before 1st Sept, 2023. Late applications will not be considered
and stand rejected.
At the time ( 11:00 a.m) of interview (physical presence is mandatory) on
September 11, 2023 at office of Director UILS, PU Chandigarh, candidates
are required to bring all the supporting documents/certificates/publications
in original. Candidates are required to report at 09:30 a.m. sharp on the
date of interview at UILS Office. Kindly be in touch with Panjab University
and UILS website for further updates.
The candidate shall have to give an undertaking that he/she will not draw
any fellowship/stipend or any financial assistance from any agency till they
are teaching at University Institute of Legal Studies, Panjab University,
Chandigarh as a Guest / Part-Time Faculty.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
